lines.title: Overview
lines.text: Process Guide turns a video or live view into a guided workflow.

lines.title: Choose a source
lines.text: Choose a video file, camera, or shared screen. Here, we use the parts sorting example.

lines.title: Add instructions
lines.text: Upload a text guide, or choose a sample. Without a document, inferred steps remain provisional.

lines.title: Set your wishes
lines.text: Set your guidance preferences and personal wishes, then open the workspace.

lines.title: Arrange the workspace
lines.text: Your source stays on the left. Drag the divider to give either side more room.

lines.title: Follow steps and principles
lines.text: Steps and principles explain the action and its purpose. Evidence shows what the system observed.

lines.title: Confirm carefully
lines.text: Review each result. Manual confirmations remain clearly separate from AI observations.

lines.title: Ask for guidance
lines.text: Ask a typed question, or use voice controls. Speech and microphone access require your action.

lines.title: Guardian observation
lines.text: Guardian adds ongoing observation. Pause guidance whenever you need to inspect the source.

lines.title: Check readiness
lines.text: In Readiness, record the job context and complete your preparation checks before work.

lines.title: Review and exceptions
lines.text: Review lets you bookmark a frame and raise an exception when evidence needs attention.

lines.title: Analysis report
lines.text: Open the analysis report to review the workflow, observations, and unresolved issues.

lines.title: Export and share
lines.text: Prepare a PDF, export offline HTML, or share the file. Reports can include session details.

lines.title: Save a result
lines.text: Create or sign in to a private local account, then save the current result.

lines.title: Return to saved results
lines.text: Saved results remain available for review on this deployment. The simulator connection is planned, and inactive.
